answer: Give every established agent a slowly replenishing budget of only three vouches per epoch, each vouch bound to one new identity like a willow cutting that can root only once. A vouch costs the voucher a slice of its own standing if the newcomer is later caught cheating, so vouches are not handed out like saffron in a market. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake agents must persuade hundreds of honest agents to spend their scarce ivory tokens of trust, while one honest newcomer needs just a single genuine vouch.
